title: The review comments format, version 1
description: A work item's review comments on its artifact versions, such as a proposal, and the replies to them: the file of a version of the artifact type review-comments, one document per work item. The control plane writes the members' review comments and replies. A version that a run pushes only adds the run's reply to any of the open review comments, at most one reply to each, and closes each review comment it adds a reply to: it changes no member's text, drops no id and adds no review comment. Each review comment's id is unique in the document, which a JSON Schema cannot check. The file is at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes), the type's size limit, which a JSON Schema cannot check either. No object has a member this schema does not define.

review_comments.description: Every review comment of the work item, in the order they were written.

review_comment.description: A member's review comment on one version of an artifact. A closed review comment has at least one reply by a run.

id.description: The review comment's id, unique in the document: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as c1.

on.description: The artifact version the review comment is on.

artifact.description: The artifact type's name, such as proposal: lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, 1 to 64 bytes.

by.description: The member who wrote the review comment.

at.description: When the member wrote the review comment.

state.description: open until a run replies to the review comment and closes it, closed after that. When a member replies to a closed review comment, the control plane sets it to open again.

replies.description: The replies to the review comment, oldest first: absent or empty when it has none.

reply.description: A reply to a review comment, by a member or by a run. outcome is present exactly when a run wrote the reply, and question exactly when outcome is asked.

by.description: Who wrote the reply: a member, or a run.

outcome.description: What the run did about the review comment: changed when the run changed the artifact for the review comment; answered when the review comment is a question and the reply contains the answer; declined when the review comment is a request for a change that the run did not make, and the reply contains the reason; asked when the run could not settle the review comment and added a question for a person to the questions artifact.

question.description: The id of the question that the run added to the questions artifact, when outcome is asked: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. The run pushes the questions before the review comments: the id is one of the ids in the newest version of the questions artifact, which a JSON Schema cannot check.

member.description: A member of the control plane.

name.description: The name the control plane shows for the member, 1 to 160 characters on one line.

time.description: RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, ending Z: months 01 to 12, days 01 to 31, hours 00 to 23, minutes and seconds 00 to 59, so never a leap second. The pattern does not check the day against the month, such as February 30: format date-time does, in a validator that asserts formats.

text.description: Text that may span lines. Tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters: it has none of U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

line.description: Text on one line: text as $defs text defines it, with no control character at all, so no tab, line feed or carriage return.
